bullets.text: Slower Apple Features Ahead - **Apple** warns UK users of potential delays in feature rollouts due to new regulations.
Apple Comedy on BBC - **Apple TV+** series 'Trying' will be available on **BBC iPlayer**, expanding its audience in the UK.
Colombia Investigates Apple - **Colombia** joins global probes into **Apple's** App Store practices amid antitrust concerns.
London's Headphone Campaign - **Transport for London** urges commuters to wear headphones to reduce noise on public transit.
Apple's Legal Battles - **Apple** fights legal cases in the UK and US over 4G patent fees, impacting future costs.
iPhone 17 Pro Rumors - Anticipation builds for the **iPhone 17 Pro**, with new features and design changes expected.
Apple Wallet Updates - **Apple Wallet** in iOS 26 introduces a toggle to disable controversial push notifications.
AI-Powered Communication - **Vocal Image** uses AI to enhance voice and communication skills, gaining traction in the app market.
New Apple TV 4K - The upcoming **Apple TV 4K** is expected to feature a significant chip upgrade for enhanced performance.
MathGPT Expands - **MathGPT.ai** expands to over 50 institutions, offering an anti-cheating AI tutor for students.
